name: Repository Improvement Cycle
description: Audit the codebase against canon, propose the single highest-value improvement, delegate implementation to engineering, and verify the result.

focus_area.description: Audit focus area: brain, lib, daemon, or infra

steps.title: Understand current standards
steps.description: Review the product and brain canon documents. Recall any prior improvement learnings from memory and responsibility history.
steps.accept_criteria: Canon invariants and quality axes are understood. Prior learnings reviewed.

steps.title: Audit the focus area
steps.description: Inspect the current focus area of the codebase. Identify gaps, inefficiencies, structural issues, or canon violations. Score findings by impact and feasibility. Select the single highest-value improvement.
steps.accept_criteria: Focus area audited. Findings ranked. Single highest-value improvement selected with clear justification.

steps.title: Write improvement proposal
steps.description: Create a structured proposal: what to change, why it matters, expected impact, scope, acceptance criteria, risk notes, and an implementation outline for the engineer.
steps.accept_criteria: Proposal document created with scope, justification, acceptance criteria, and implementation outline.

steps.title: Get approval
steps.description: Present the proposal for operator approval before proceeding with implementation.
steps.approval_message: 🏗️ **Improvement proposed**: Review the proposal above. Approve to delegate implementation to an engineer, or reject to skip this cycle.
steps.accept_criteria: Operator has approved or rejected the proposal.

steps.title: Delegate implementation
steps.description: Delegate the approved improvement to an engineer on the project team. Provide the proposal, scope, and acceptance criteria.
steps.accept_criteria: Delegation sent to engineer. Implementation work initiated.

steps.title: Verify and learn
steps.description: Review the engineer's work against canon standards. Verify the improvement was delivered as proposed. Record what was learned for future improvement cycles.
steps.accept_criteria: Results verified against canon. Learnings recorded for future cycles.
